fills.researcher_notes: This is a per-COMPANY question, not per-row (gotcha 4): Florida Gas Transmission Company, LLC is held by Citrus Corp, a 50/50 joint venture of Kinder Morgan and Energy Transfer, and OPERATED by Energy Transfer -- not the current sheet Owner cell's name, and not the wiki's naive suggestion ('Florida Gas Transmission Company LLC', which just repeats the Owner value and answers 'who owns the SPV', not 'who operates it'). Two independent sources: (1) Kinder Morgan's own pipelines page -- FGT's 50/50 JV PARTNER, so genuinely independent of Energy Transfer's own claims about itself -- states verbatim 'Citrus Corp is a 50/50 joint venture between Kinder Morgan, Inc. (NYSE: KMI) and Energy Transfer Partners, L.P. (Energy Transfer). FGT is operated by Energy Transfer.' (2) Wikipedia's Florida Gas Transmission article states 'The pipeline is owned 50% by Energy Transfer Partners (Owner/Operator) and 50% by Kinder Morgan Partnership'. Recorded as 'Energy Transfer' per the tracker's existing short-form convention for this company elsewhere on the operators/owners tab (not 'Energy Transfer LP' or 'Energy Transfer Partners'). This determination applies to the whole FGT system; no other row in this brief carries an Operator flag for FGT. Operator is written 'Energy Transfer' by the source; spelled the ownership team's way as 'Energy Transfer LP'.
